transformation_logic: Auto-generated sequential surrogate primary key starting from 1

RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY standard_price DESC) — assigns rank 1 to the highest priced product within each category; used by consumers to filter for rank = 1 to retrieve the highest priced product per category

MAX(standard_price) OVER (PARTITION BY category) — window function returning the maximum standard_price within each category partition; enables direct comparison of each product price against its category maximum without pre-aggregation

MAX(standard_price) OVER (PARTITION BY category) - standard_price — calculates the difference between the category maximum price and the individual product price; equals 0 for the highest priced product in each category
Passthrough from products_silver._load_timestamp cast to TIMESTAMP; represents the data load time from the silver layer
CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() at the time of gold layer ETL execution; system-generated audit column recording when the record was written to the gold table
